_comment: Certificate authorities whose names must never appear in the issuer field of a certificate presented for a link under investigation. Matching is a case-insensitive substring test against every issuer attribute (O, OU, CN) and the full RFC4514 issuer string, so a leaf or intermediate issued under any of these names is flagged.

distrusted_cas.name: DigiNotar
distrusted_cas.reason: Dutch CA breached in 2011; rogue certificates were issued for major domains and the root was removed from trust stores.

distrusted_cas.name: eMudhra
distrusted_cas.reason: Indian CA repeatedly implicated in certificates issued for look-alike financial and government domains; treated as distrusted by this tool.

distrusted_cas.name: Symantec
distrusted_cas.reason: Symantec/GeoTrust/Thawte/VeriSign root programme was distrusted by browsers after mis-issuance incidents; legacy chains are treated as compromised.
